content: Featurebase statuses have fixed types (Reviewing, Planned, Active, Completed, Canceled) with custom names/colors; one status is the default; deleting a status moves its requests to the current default status. Canny defaults: Open, Under Review, Planned, In Progress, Complete, Closed; public roadmap shows 3 chosen statuses. (help.featurebase.app 6979960, help.canny.io 673583)
